steps.say: A prefix is a group of letters added to the front of a word. It changes what the word means.
Un- means not. Unkind means not kind, and unsafe means not safe.
Dis- also means not, or the opposite. Disagree means not agree.
Re- means again or back. Rebuild means build again.
The root word keeps all its letters. Just add the prefix to the front.
Some words only start with these letters. Uncle and ready have no prefix.

options.why: Rekind is not a word. Re- means again.
Diskind is not a word. Kind takes a different prefix.
Kindly means in a kind way.

hints: Not kind is the opposite of kind.
Which prefix means not and goes with kind?
Try un, re and dis in front of kind. Say each one aloud.
check.explanation: Un- means not, so unkind means not kind.

hints: The bridge needs to be built again.
